text:
maria: Quick heads-up — since the kernel-selection v2 rollout last night, we've seen ~18-22% drop in prefix cache hit-rate for rwkv-13b-quant on /generate and /chat routes for a handful of tenants. Sparklines on the dashboard show the decline starting around 2026-03-14 22:30 UTC.

ci-bot: deploy: kernel-selection v2 rolled to prod (commit abc123) 2026-03-15T03:12:08Z :package:

aj: On it. Can you paste the exact panel query you're using?

maria: Sure — here's the query powering the token-saved panel (Grafana / ClickHouse):
```
SELECT tenant_id, route, model, 
  sum(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved, 
  sum(tokens_requested) AS tokens_in, 
  tokens_saved / tokens_in AS hit_rate
FROM prefix_cache.events
WHERE time >= now() - interval 7 day
GROUP BY tenant_id, route, model
ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC
```

sophie: Two hypotheses: 1) kernel selection changed pre-tokenization/normalization (tiny whitespace/sep diffs => different cache keys), or 2) batching heuristics changed sequence boundaries so warmups miss more often.

ken: Confirmed — PR #4892 flipped `normalize_whitespace` to true inside the kernel path to stabilize attention kernels. That alters pre-token normalization before key derivation. We also bumped the sequence batching window (128 -> 192) in the same deploy.

maria: That matches the tenant slice: high long-turn customers show the worst drop. I'd like a per-tenant, per-route sparkline panel with 6h / 24h aggregates and an alert when relative hit_rate drops >10% vs baseline (baseline = 7d moving average).

aj: Agreed. Also add a compact heatmap that shows top 50 keys by frequency and a checksum compare of key derivation before/after (we can recompute from sampled prefixes). I'll open a dashboard PR.

sophie: Recommend sampling raw prefixes from affected tenants (obfuscated/hashed) and running both key-derivation logic versions locally to diff outputs. If normalization differs, we can either revert the flag or add a key-normalizer shim prior to keying to preserve cache compatibility.

ken: I'll draft a canary rollback plan and a targeted toggle for the normalization flag on the affected pools. If the sample diffs show the flag as the culprit, we can toggle it off and re-evaluate.

maria: Action items:
- aj: dashboard PR with these panels + alert (6h/24h sparklines, per-model/per-route/per-tenant) — EOD
- sophie: run sampled key-derivation diffs + paste top mismatches — 4h
- ken: canary rollback plan + toggle patch — 2h

aj: will do. tagging observers @sophie @ken :eyes: 

ci-bot: alert created: prefix_cache.hitrate_relative_drop (>10%) — threshold configured for /generate and /chat routes, notify #eng-runtime

ken: FYI — data retention for raw prefix samples is limited; I'll coordinate with privacy to ensure we only sample hashed prefixes and keep TTL short.

maria: Thanks team. I have a small harness to replay warmups locally against both kernels if anyone wants repro.

aj: Nice. Please drop the harness link and I'll wire the dashboard panels to that dataset.

maria: https://internal/redwood/harnesses/prefix-replay/sha256:abcd1234

sophie: Good plan. Will share diff results in this thread when ready.

maria: closing loop — will post a short postmortem once we have root cause and remediation.
